text: Run real device/emulator verification for the Android app

Recurring flaky Compose UI test observed during T-31/T-32 work: AddItemDialogTest ('...picking a suggestion sets it todo and dismisses') intermittently fails on the final assertEquals(true, dismissed) under FULL-suite load but passes reliably in isolation (verified both). Root cause: the save()/pickSuggestion viewModelScope coroutine races composeTestRule.waitForIdle() — waitForIdle doesn't await viewModelScope work. General fix for these Robolectric+Compose tests: replace 'waitForIdle(); assert' with composeTestRule.waitUntil { <condition> } (or await the VM Job), so they don't depend on coroutine timing. Affects several ...ScreenTest/...DialogTest classes. Not a product bug.
